message.content: The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) resulted in roughly **25,000 casualties** (killed, wounded, or missing) on both sides combined. This figure is an estimate based on contemporary reports and modern scholarship; exact numbers vary slightly among historians. For more detail, see the “Casualties” section of the [Battle of Waterloo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Waterloo) article on Wikipedia.
